title: Ukraine Hits 16 Targets Across Russia, Destroys Wildberries Warehouse, Kills 3
detail: President Zelensky said Ukrainian forces struck 16 targets across Russia over the past day, including oil facilities, logistics hubs, airfields, a missile unit, a military enterprise, and infrastructure Moscow uses to launch attacks on Ukraine, declaring 'the war must return to where it came from.' A Wildberries logistics center in Kotovsk, Tambov Oblast (roughly 500 km southeast of Moscow) was 'completely destroyed by fire' across about 100,000 square meters, regional governor Yevgeny Pervyshov said, injuring 1 person. Ukraine's General Staff also confirmed a strike on Lukoil's NORSI oil refinery in Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, sparking a fire. Elsewhere, drone strikes killed a man and a 14-year-old in a fire in Lipetsk Oblast and a woman in Belgorod Oblast. Russia's Defense Ministry said it intercepted 426 Ukrainian drones overnight, including over occupied Ukrainian territory.

media.caption: Smoke billows from a burning Wildberries warehouse following a Ukrainian drone attack in Russia, August 26, 2026
